live_primary_web_reads.application_and_limit: Geometrically unibranch irreducible schemes have normalization a universal homeomorphism; retain reduced integral finite-type hypotheses.
Normal local domains are geometrically unibranch; used only for the normal intermediate target.
Projective birational resolution of an integral normal target has geometrically connected fibers. Properness, reducedness, domination and generic H0 identity are checked in the addendum.
Smooth Bertini on the blowup uses a globally generated very ample complete system and its immersion, with finitely many proper-intersection conditions.
Ample hyperplane sections of smooth projective connected schemes of dimension at least two are connected; properness and depth hypotheses are retained.
Combines smooth and connected hyperplane sections. The resulting curve maps algebraically to the original variety through the blowup.
Normality descends faithfully flatly for the finitely presented normalization data; finite birational normal algebra is the integral closure in the common fraction field.
Universal-homeomorphism property descends fpqc for the finite normalization. No analytic function descent follows from this alone.
One local normalization point with purely inseparable residue extension yields geometric unibranchness of the descended scheme.
